rubricName: Security - OWASP Top 10:2025 - Billing-Cycle Mid-Cycle Subscription Upgrade

evalCriteria.prompt: Review the two new billing endpoints. Score 0 if either endpoint reads or mutates billing_data/users for an email value the caller does not own without any ownership/session check equivalent to the rest of this codebase's existing pattern, or if the email in the request body/query is trusted without matching the caller's authenticated identity as established by AuthContext.jsx's existing convention. Cite file and line.

Review the upgrade business logic (proration, gateway call, plan-flip mutation, already-Premium guard). Score 0 if the already-Premium guard is missing on either endpoint, if the failure path allows any partial mutation, or if the proration amount can be manipulated by client-supplied input rather than computed purely server-side from stored state. Cite file and line.

Review how the two new endpoints identify the caller. Score 0 if either endpoint accepts an arbitrary email value with no verification against the existing email-as-token authentication convention already used by GET /api/billing, allowing one user to upgrade or query another user's plan. Cite file and line.

Review any new log statement in the diff. Score 0 if a changed log call writes the full email, charge amount tied to an identifiable user, or any raw request/response body that is unnecessary for operational logging, in a way inconsistent with the rest of the codebase's logging (or lack thereof). Cite file and line.

Review the new endpoint definitions for HTTP method, status codes, and error response shape. Score 0 if a changed endpoint returns a broader CORS/response surface than the existing /api/billing endpoint, or leaks stack traces/debug detail in an error response. Cite file and line.

Review error handling in both new endpoints (missing email, malformed renew_at, unexpected gateway result). Score 0 if an unhandled exception in a changed code path would surface a raw stack trace, an ambiguous 500 in place of a documented 402/409, or leave billing_data/users in an inconsistent state. Cite file and line.
